source_refs.note: Book p. 140-142: unit introduction, 5.1 general, slope-intercept, point-slope, two-point, intercept and normal forms; Examples 1-5

blocks.text: Introduction

Assalam-o-alaikum bachon! Aaj se hum ek naya unit shuru kar rahe hain: Analytical Geometry, jise coordinate geometry bhi kehte hain. Is ka kamaal yeh hai ke yeh algebra aur geometry ko aapas mein jor deti hai. Pehle hum lines aur shapes sirf kaghaz par draw karte the ya zehan mein tasawwur karte the. Ab hum unhein xy-plane par points aur equations ki shakal mein likhenge. Jab shape equation ban jaye to us par calculation karna aasan ho jata hai: do points ka faasla (distance), mid-point, slope (dhalwaan) aur do lines ka intersection point (milne ki jagah), sab formulas se nikal aate hain.

Kitab batati hai ke is ki madad se amli masail (practical problems) hal hote hain, jaise sab se chhota rasta dhoondna, yeh check karna ke do lines parallel hain ya nahi, ya kisi cheez ki bilkul durust position maloom karna. Socho, ek satellite ya ek suspension bridge (latakne wala pul) banane wale engineer ko har point ki exact jagah chahiye hoti hai; yahi kaam coordinates karte hain.

Yeh ilm 17th century mein French mathematician René Descartes ne shuru kiya. Unhon ne yeh idea diya ke geometric figures ko coordinates se represent kiya jaye. Unka kaam algebra aur geometry ke darmiyan pul ban gaya aur modern mathematics ki bunyaad bana.

Is unit mein hum parhenge: straight lines, do coplanar (ek hi plane mein) intersecting lines ke darmiyan angle, triangle ke medians, right bisectors aur altitudes ka concurrent hona (ek hi point se guzarna), triangular region ka area, aur asal zindagi mein analytical geometry ka istemal.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Class XI ke teen auzaar (tools) is poore unit mein har safhe par kaam aayenge. Abhi in ko dobara yaad kar lijiye:
1. Do points \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \((x_{2}, y_{2})\) se guzarne wali line ka slope:
\[m = \dfrac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\]
Slope batata hai ke \(x\) ek qadam aage barhe to \(y\) kitna upar jata hai. Agar line positive x-axis ke saath angle \(\alpha\) banaye to \(m = \tan\alpha\). Seedhi chadhai wali sarak ka slope zyada, halki dhalwaan ka kam.
2. Do points ko milane wale segment ka mid-point (darmiyani point):
\[\left(\dfrac{x_{1}+x_{2}}{2}, \dfrac{y_{1}+y_{2}}{2}\right)\]
Yani dono x ka average aur dono y ka average.
3. Koi point kisi line par tab hi hota hai jab us ke coordinates line ki equation ko satisfy karein (equation mein rakhne se dono taraf barabar ho jayein). Isi se hum har jawab ki tasdeeq karte hain.

Ab Section 5.1. Kitab kehti hai ke hum pehle seekh chuke hain ke coordinate geometry mein ek straight line ko mukhtalif forms mein likha ja sakta hai; kaun si form istemal karni hai, yeh is par depend karta hai ke sawal mein humein kya information di gayi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Is baat ko yun samjhiye: ek seedhi line poori tarah fix karne ke liye do cheezein kaafi hain. Ya to ek point aur direction (slope); ya do points; ya dono intercepts (axes ko kaatne ki jagah); ya origin se us ka faasla aur perpendicular ki direction. Har qisam ki information se equation ki apni form banti hai. Lekin yaad rakhiye, yeh sab ek hi cheez ki mukhtalif shakalein hain, jaise ek hi aadmi ka naam, CNIC number aur ghar ka pata: teeno se wohi shakhs pehchana jata hai. Simplify karne ke baad har form \(ax + by + c = 0\) ban jati hai.
General Form
Do variables mein straight line ki general form \(ax + by + c = 0\) hai, jahan \(a\), \(b\) aur \(c\) real numbers hain aur \(a\) aur \(b\) dono ek saath zero nahi ho sakte.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: \(a\) aur \(b\) dono zero kyun nahi ho sakte? Agar \(a = b = 0\) ho to equation sirf \(c = 0\) reh jati hai: na \(x\) bacha na \(y\). Aisi equation koi line describe hi nahi karti. Ek aur zaroori baat: poori equation ko kisi bhi non-zero number se multiply karein to line wohi rehti hai. \(2x - y - 6 = 0\) aur \(4x - 2y - 12 = 0\) bilkul ek hi line hain. Is liye hum aam tor par common factor aur fractions khatam kar dete hain aur \(x\) ka coefficient positive rakhte hain, taake jawab saaf suthra lage aur kitab ke answer se milana aasan ho.
Slope-Intercept Form
Agar line ka slope \(m\) ho aur y-intercept \(c\) ho, to slope-intercept form mein us ki equation \(y = mx + c\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: y-intercept \(c\) ka matlab hai ke line y-axis ko point \((0, c)\) par kaat-ti hai. \(y = mx + c\) mein \(x = 0\) rakhein to \(y = c\) milta hai; bas yahi wajah hai. Yeh form kab istemal karein? Jab sawal mein slope aur y-intercept diye hon. Aur ulta kaam bhi isi se hota hai: kisi equation ka slope dekhna ho to use \(y\) ke liye hal kar dein; \(x\) ke saath jo number hai wohi slope hai. Misaal: \(5x + y + 17 = 0\) se \(y = -5x - 17\), yani slope \(-5\).
Point-Slope Form
Agar line kisi point \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) se guzarti ho aur us ka slope \(m\) ho, to point-slope form mein equation \(y - y_{1} = m(x - x_{1})\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh formula aaya kahan se? Line par koi bhi doosra point \((x, y)\) lein. \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \((x, y)\) ke darmiyan slope bhi \(m\) hi hona chahiye, kyunke seedhi line ka slope har jagah ek jaisa hota hai:
\[\dfrac{y - y_{1}}{x - x_{1}} = m\]
Dono taraf \(x - x_{1}\) se multiply karein to point-slope form mil jati hai. Yeh is unit ki sab se zyada kaam aane wali form hai: medians, altitudes aur right bisectors sab isi se likhe jayenge. Is ko achhi tarah pakka kar lijiye.
Two-Point Form

Agar line do points \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \((x_{2}, y_{2})\) se guzarti ho, to two-point form mein us ki equation yeh hai:
\[\dfrac{y - y_{2}}{y_{2} - y_{1}} = \dfrac{x - x_{2}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\]
ya
\[\dfrac{y - y_{1}}{y_{1} - y_{2}} = \dfrac{x - x_{1}}{x_{1} - x_{2}}\]
ya
\[y - y_{1} = \dfrac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}(x - x_{1})\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Teesri shakal sab se zyada samajh aane wali hai: pehle dono points se slope \(m = \frac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\) nikalo, phir point-slope form laga do. Pehli do shaklein wohi equation hain, bas fractions ki soorat mein. Rattay ki zaroorat nahi: slope nikalna aur point-slope lagana aata ho to two-point form khud ban jati hai. Agar \(x_{1} = x_{2}\) ho to slope undefined (na-maloom, kyunke neeche zero aata hai) hai, aur line seedhi khari (vertical) line \(x = x_{1}\) hai.
Intercept Form

Agar line ka x-intercept \(a\) aur y-intercept \(b\) ho, to intercept form mein equation yeh hai:
\[\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Khud tasdeeq kijiye: \(y = 0\) rakhein to \(x = a\), yani line x-axis ko \((a, 0)\) par milti hai; \(x = 0\) rakhein to \(y = b\), yani y-axis ko \((0, b)\) par. Intercepts negative bhi ho sakte hain, aur sign ke saath hi likhe jate hain. Yeh form har line ke liye nahi chalti: jo line origin se guzre (dono intercepts zero) ya kisi axis ke parallel ho, us ke liye yeh form nahi banti, kyunke zero se taqseem nahi ho sakti.
Normal Form

\(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = p\) straight line ki equation hai, jahan \(p\) origin se line ka perpendicular faasla (seedha, sab se chhota faasla) hai aur \(\theta\) woh angle hai jo yeh perpendicular positive x-axis ke saath banata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Tasweer zehan mein banaiye: origin \(O\) se line par perpendicular giraiye. Us ki lambai \(p\) hai (is liye \(p \ge 0\)) aur woh positive x-axis se angle \(\theta\) banata hai. Is perpendicular ka qadam (foot) yeh point hai:
\[N(p\cos\theta, p\sin\theta)\]
Line \(N\) se guzarti hai aur \(ON\) par perpendicular hai. 'Normal' ka matlab hi perpendicular (amood) hai. Dhyan dein: \(\theta\) line ka angle nahi, perpendicular ka angle hai. Is form mein right-hand side \(p\) kabhi negative nahi hota, aur coefficients ke liye \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta = 1\) hota hai.

rows: Origin se faasla \(p\) aur perpendicular ka angle \(\theta\)
blocks.caption: Hamara khulasa: kaun si form kab

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar sawal mein sirf yeh diya ho ke line \((2, 5)\) se guzarti hai aur x-axis ke parallel hai, to kaun si form lagayenge? (Ishara: x-axis ke parallel line ka slope zero hota hai. Point-slope se \(y - 5 = 0(x - 2)\), yani \(y = 5\).)

Ab misaalon ki taraf chalte hain. Har misaal mein hum pehle dekhenge ke kya diya gaya hai, phir faisla karenge ke kaun si form fit hoti hai, aur aakhir mein jawab ko check karenge. Pehli misaal mein slope aur y-intercept diye gaye hain, to aap ko pehle hi andaza ho jana chahiye ke kaun si form lagegi.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.problem: Find an equation of the straight line if its slope is 3 and y-intercept is 7.
steps:
Diya gaya: slope \(m = 3\), y-intercept \(c = 7\).
Maloom karna: line ki equation.
Tareeqa: slope aur y-intercept dono diye hain, is liye seedha slope-intercept form \(y = mx + c\) lagegi. Is se aasan form koi nahi.

Di gayi values pehchaniye
Line ka slope aur y-intercept tarteeb se:
\[m = 3, \quad c = 7\]
Kyun: formula mein rakhne se pehle saaf likh lena chahiye ke kaun sa number \(m\) hai aur kaun sa \(c\); is se ghalti ka chance kam hota hai.

Slope-intercept form mein rakhiye
\[y = mx + c\]
\[y = 3x + 7\]
Kyun: is form ko sirf yahi do numbers chahiye. Bas rakh diye aur equation tayyar.

Tasdeeq:
\(x = 0\) par \(y = 7\), yani line y-axis ko \((0, 7)\) par kaat-ti hai. \(x = 0\) se \(x = 1\) tak \(y\) 7 se 10 ho jata hai, yani 3 ka izafa: slope 3. Dono shartein poori.

blocks.text: Ek chhota sa mashwara: misaal shuru karne se pehle hamesha teen sawal khud se poochiye. Pehla, mujhe kya diya gaya hai? Doosra, mujhe kya nikalna hai? Teesra, diye gaye aur matloob ko kaun sa formula jorta hai? Jab yeh teen jawab saaf hon, to aadha sawal wahin hal ho jata hai. Ab dekhiye yeh tareeqa doosri misaal mein kaise kaam karta hai.
Doosri misaal mein ek point aur slope diya hai. Jab bhi 'point aur slope' ka jora dekhein, zehan mein foran point-slope form aani chahiye.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.problem: Write down an equation of the straight line passing through \((-4, 3)\) and having slope \(-5\).
steps:
Diya gaya: point \((x_{1}, y_{1}) = (-4, 3)\), slope \(m = -5\).
Maloom karna: line ki equation.
Tareeqa: ek point aur slope diye hain, is liye point-slope form \(y - y_{1} = m(x - x_{1})\) bilkul fit hai.

Point-slope form mein values rakhiye
Point \((-4, 3)\) line par hai aur slope \(-5\) hai, is liye:
\[y - 3 = -5(x - (-4))\]
\[y - 3 = -5(x + 4)\]
Kyun: \(x_{1} = -4\) hai, to \(x - x_{1} = x - (-4) = x + 4\). Minus aur minus mil kar plus ban jate hain.
Dhyan dein: brackets zaroor lagaiye. Sab se zyada ghaltiyan yahin negative signs mein hoti hain.

Bracket kholiye aur simplify kijiye
\[y - 3 = -5x - 20\]
\[5x + y + 17 = 0\]
Yahi matloob line ki equation hai.
Kyun: dono taraf \(5x + 20\) jor diya taake saare terms ek taraf aa jayein aur general form ban jaye. \(-3 + 20 = 17\). Aap chahein to \(y = -5x - 17\) par bhi ruk sakte hain; yeh slope-intercept form hai aur bilkul wohi line hai.

Tasdeeq:
\((-4, 3)\) rakhiye: \(5(-4) + 3 + 17 = -20 + 20 = 0\). Theek. Aur \(y\) ke liye hal karein to \(y = -5x - 17\), slope \(-5\). Dono baatein poori.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar slope \(-5\) ke bajaye \(+5\) hota aur point wohi \((-4, 3)\), to jawab kya hota? Khud hal kar ke dekhiye. (Jawab: \(y - 3 = 5(x + 4)\), yani \(5x - y + 23 = 0\).)
Teesri misaal mein do points diye gaye hain. Yahan two-point form lagegi. Aap chahein to pehle slope nikal kar point-slope bhi laga sakte hain; jawab ek hi aayega.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: Find an equation of the straight line passing through the points \((-3, -2)\) and \((5, 4)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \((x_{1}, y_{1}) = (-3, -2)\) aur \((x_{2}, y_{2}) = (5, 4)\).
Maloom karna: in dono points se guzarne wali line ki equation.
Tareeqa: do points diye hain, is liye two-point form.

Two-point form likhiye
\[\dfrac{y - (-2)}{4 - (-2)} = \dfrac{x - (-3)}{5 - (-3)}\]
\[\dfrac{y + 2}{6} = \dfrac{x + 3}{8}\]
Kyun: formula \(\frac{y - y_{1}}{y_{2} - y_{1}} = \frac{x - x_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\) hai. Negative number ko minus karna dar-asal jama karna hai: \(4 - (-2) = 6\), \(5 - (-3) = 8\).

Fractions khatam kijiye
\[y + 2 = \dfrac{6}{8}(x + 3)\]
\[8(y + 2) = 6(x + 3)\]
Kyun: cross-multiplication (aar-paar zarb) se dono denominators ek saath khatam ho jate hain. Note kijiye ke \(\frac{6}{8} = \frac{3}{4}\) hi line ka slope hai.

General form tak simplify kijiye
\[8y + 16 = 6x + 18\]
\[6x - 8y + 2 = 0\]
\[3x - 4y + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: saare terms ek taraf le aaye, phir har term ko common factor 2 se taqseem kar diya taake jawab sab se saada shakal mein ho.

Tasdeeq:
\((-3, -2)\): \(-9 + 8 + 1 = 0\). \((5, 4)\): \(15 - 16 + 1 = 0\). Dono points equation ko satisfy karte hain, yani line dono se guzarti hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yahi sawal doosre tareeqe se: slope
\[m = \dfrac{4 - (-2)}{5 - (-3)} = \dfrac{6}{8} = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
Point \((5, 4)\) aur point-slope form:
\[y - 4 = \dfrac{3}{4}(x - 5)\]
\(4y - 16 = 3x - 15\), yani \(3x - 4y + 1 = 0\). Bilkul wohi jawab. Is se pata chalta hai ke kaun sa point istemal karein, farq nahi parta.
Chauthi misaal mein line dono axes ko kaat rahi hai aur kaatne ke points diye hain. Jab x-axis aur y-axis wale points diye hon, to intercept form sab se tez hai.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem: Write down an equation of the straight line which cuts the x-axis at \((3, 0)\) and y-axis at \((0, -6)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: line x-axis ko \((3, 0)\) par aur y-axis ko \((0, -6)\) par kaat-ti hai.
Maloom karna: line ki equation.
Tareeqa: dono intercepts maloom hain: \(a = 3\), \(b = -6\). Is liye two-intercept form \(\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1\).

Intercepts formula mein rakhiye
\[\dfrac{x}{3} + \dfrac{y}{-6} = 1\]
Kyun: intercept woh number hai jahan line axis ko kaat-ti hai, apne sign ke saath. Yahan y-intercept \(-6\) hai, 6 nahi.
Dhyan dein: bohat se bachay yahan minus chhor dete hain aur jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

Fractions khatam kijiye
\[2x - y = 6\]
\[2x - y - 6 = 0\]
Kyun: dono taraf 6 se multiply kiya (3 aur 6 ka L.C.M.): \(6 \cdot \frac{x}{3} = 2x\), \(6 \cdot \frac{y}{-6} = -y\), aur \(6 \cdot 1 = 6\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 4 ki line ka slope kya hai? Do tareeqe hain. Pehla: dono points \((3, 0)\) aur \((0, -6)\) se \(m = \frac{-6 - 0}{0 - 3} = 2\). Doosra: \(2x - y - 6 = 0\) ko \(y = 2x - 6\) likhein, slope 2 aur y-intercept \(-6\). Dono ka jawab ek hai, aur y-intercept bhi wohi \(-6\) hai jo sawal mein diya tha. Yeh is baat ka saboot hai ke hamari equation durust hai.
Paanchvi misaal thori mukhtalif hai. Is mein na koi point diya hai na slope; balke origin se line ka faasla aur us perpendicular ka angle diya hai. Yahi normal form ki information hai.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.problem: The length of perpendicular from the origin to a line is 3 units and the inclination of this perpendicular is \(120^\circ\). Find the equation of the straight line.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(p = 3\), \(\theta = 120^\circ\).
Maloom karna: line ki equation.
Tareeqa: origin se perpendicular faasla aur perpendicular ka angle, yeh bilkul normal form \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = p\) ki information hai.

Normal form likhiye
\[x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = p\]
\[x\cos 120^\circ + y\sin 120^\circ = 3\]
Kyun: sirf \(\theta\) aur \(p\) ki values rakhni hain.

Trigonometric values daliye
\[-\dfrac{1}{2}x + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}y = 3\]
Kyun: \(120^\circ\) second quadrant mein hai, jahan cos negative aur sin positive hota hai: \(\cos 120^\circ = -\cos 60^\circ = -\frac{1}{2}\), \(\sin 120^\circ = \sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 120^\circ\) ko \(+\frac{1}{2}\) lena sab se aam ghalti hai.

Simplify kijiye
\[x - \sqrt{3}y = -6\]
\[x - \sqrt{3}y + 6 = 0\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(-2\) se multiply kiya: fractions bhi khatam aur \(x\) ka coefficient bhi positive. Har term ka sign badal gaya.

Tasdeeq:
Origin se faasla \(= \frac{|6|}{\sqrt{1 + 3}} = \frac{6}{2} = 3 = p\). Perpendicular ka foot \((3\cos 120^\circ, 3\sin 120^\circ) = (-\frac{3}{2}, \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2})\) bhi equation ko satisfy karta hai: \(-\frac{3}{2} - \frac{9}{2} + 6 = 0\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar \(p = 3\) aur \(\theta = 0^\circ\) ho to line kaun si hogi? (Jawab: \(x\cos 0^\circ + y\sin 0^\circ = 3\), yani \(x = 3\): y-axis ke parallel line jo origin se 3 units door hai. Perpendicular x-axis ke saath hai, is liye line khud vertical hai.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ulta sawal: line \(x + y - 4 = 0\) ko normal form mein likhiye.
Pehle constant ko right side le jayein: \(x + y = 4\). Right side positive hai, achha hai. Ab poori equation ko \(\sqrt{1^{2} + 1^{2}} = \sqrt{2}\) se taqseem karein:
\[\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}x + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}y = \dfrac{4}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Yahan \(\cos\theta = \sin\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), yani \(\theta = 45^\circ\), aur \(p = \frac{4}{\sqrt{2}} = 2\sqrt{2}\). Is taqseem ka poora tareeqa (aur sign ka faisla) Section 5.2.1 mein aayega; abhi sirf yeh dekh lijiye ke normal form mein \(x\) aur \(y\) ke coefficients ke squares ka jor 1 hota hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Board ke paper mein aksar sawal sirf itna hota hai: 'equation of the line' find karein. Aap kisi bhi form mein shuru karein, lekin aakhri jawab general form \(ax + by + c = 0\) mein likhiye, fractions aur common factors khatam kar ke, aur \(x\) ka coefficient positive rakh kar. Is tarah aap ka jawab kitab ke answer se seedha mil jata hai aur examiner ko check karne mein aasani hoti hai. Aakhir mein do second laga kar diye gaye point ko equation mein rakh kar dekh lijiye; yeh chhoti si aadat bohat se marks bachati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. General form: \(ax + by + c = 0\), jahan \(a\) aur \(b\) dono zero nahi. Har form simplify ho kar yahi banti hai.
2. Slope-intercept \(y = mx + c\); point-slope \(y - y_{1} = m(x - x_{1})\); two-point: pehle points se \(m\), phir point-slope.
3. Intercept form \(\frac{x}{a} + \frac{y}{b} = 1\): \(a\), \(b\) apne sign ke saath intercepts hain.
4. Normal form \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta = p\): \(p \ge 0\) origin se faasla, \(\theta\) perpendicular ka angle (line ka nahi).
5. Har jawab ki tasdeeq: diye gaye point(s) aap ki final equation ko satisfy karne chahiyein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Negative coordinates ke saath sign ki ghalti: \(x - (-4) = x + 4\) hai, \(x - 4\) nahi.
2. y-intercept ko point samajh lena: y-intercept number \(c\) hai; point \((0, c)\) hai.
3. Intercept form mein negative intercept ka minus chhor dena: \(\frac{y}{-6}\) likhna hai, \(\frac{y}{6}\) nahi.
4. Normal form mein perpendicular ke bajaye line ka angle le lena, ya \(\cos 120^\circ = +\frac{1}{2}\) le lena.
5. Fractions khatam karte waqt kisi ek term ko multiply karna bhool jana (khaas tor par right-hand side ka 1).
